note: Smooth pieces for the building card and the upgrade popup (Docs/art/ui-menus-redesign.md §7.27). Cut by scripts/ui-cut.mjs, which FINDS the pieces rather than slicing a grid — these sheets are not one. Names are in reading order, left to right then top to bottom; run `node scripts/ui-cut.mjs --list` to see what each index picked up. `size` is the LONG side of a piece, so nothing is letterboxed; `square: true` centres it in a square canvas instead, for a ring that has to sit dead centre of what it is layered over.

sheets.note: Panel frames, used as CSS border-image. The two plank-headed ones carry the rope tie; the rest are plain wells.
Button slabs as border-image, plus the popup's close knob. Green is the primary action, wood the secondary, grey the refused one — the three states the Upgrade button walks through.

The training queue's chrome. Three ring states over one well: idle, selected (gold), and in progress (the green arc). `queue_link` is the connector between two slots and `count_pill` the xN badge, so neither is square. The three ring states arrive with a face painted inside them; `punchInner` takes it out so the rim can sit over whichever trainee the slot holds. `ring_locked` keeps its silhouette — that IS the locked slot.

The Townhall at its four levels — the portrait the card and the popup both draw, so an upgrade shows what the building BECOMES. The scroll is the level ribbon; the glow ring is the map's selection halo.

Busts on the top row, bodies under them — the two files every trainee ships (Docs/art/portraits/unit-blocks.md §2). These REPLACE the rendered 3D set: the card draws them beside painted chrome now, and the two styles could not share a panel.
